current.title: GFG-BS settlement, Arc game core, lives + subscription (osv1Arc)

items.t: (1) GFG-BS redesign: NO off-chain state
(1i) Delete the file batch store; no Supabase for core logic
(1ii) On-chain leaf add + window finalize, game-agnostic
(1iii) Relayer signs only; window derived from chain, restart-safe
(1iv) Dashboard gas/window read from chain events, not files
(1v) GASLESS COST FIX: per-MATCH settlement + batching
(1v-a) DESIGN LOCKED + recorded in arcv2m17
(1v-b) Lives rule fixed everywhere: charged at start, non-refundable
(1v-c) MatchSettlement contract: commitStart + co-signed settle + dispute + timeout (6/6 tests)
(1v-d) Off-chain match engine: deterministic digest, devices agree, tamper detectable
(1v-e) MEASURED: 60-move match = 2 txs, 0.005949 USDC
(1v-f) GAME-AGNOSTIC settlement rail + free match history + relayer matchHistory
(1v-g) ON-CHAIN MATCH HISTORY on the game page with clickable start/end links (FREE reads)
(1v-h) Ludo wired to the rail: ZERO per-action txs; dice + moves + turns off-chain
(1v-i) BATCHING SPINE: hybrid window (100 or 1h, SKIP EMPTY) + batch starts AND settlements
(1v-i-1) Spec recorded: window + free dispute + verifiability + per-match timing rules
(1v-i-2) Window manager in the relayer (100 or 1h, never flush empty)
(1v-i-3) Batch start commits + settlements into the window flush (one leaf per MATCH)
(1v-i-4) Match history shows 'pending flush' then the BATCH tx link
(1v-i-5) Cost proof + $/1,000 table (measured 136,598 gas/flush)
(1v-i-6) Cost explanation PERMANENT in staff Test results workspace (tests.json)
(1v-i-7) FIX: start commits + settlements must actually reach the chain (rail scripts loaded before the bridge)

(1v-i-8) FIX matchHistory on the live site: the relay baked fallback was missing matchSettlement, so when the server could not fetch arc-config.json the history read a null address and returned unreadable - fixed + defensive guard

(1v-i-9) FIX duplicate start commit: the 1s tick fired ensureStarted twice while the first commit was still in flight, so a second identical commit reverted on-chain with Exists() (one wasted tx) - single-flight guard added
(1v-i-10) PROVE the batch end to end on the live site (start -> play -> flush -> history shows the batch tx)
(2) Game core on Arc (arcv2m1, game-agnostic)
(2i) Board moves signed + committed per window (DEPRECATED: replaced by (1v))
(2i-1) commitMove on-chain + relayer + gateway (DEPRECATED for gameplay)
(2i-2) Arc game-flow bridge (openGame/seatUp/beginGame/commitMove per turn) (DEPRECATED when (1v) lands)
(2ii) TURN TIMERS / game clocks enforced ON-CHAIN + permissionless expire
(2ii-1) Contract turn clock + permissionless expireTurn (DEPRECATED: keep the RULE)
(2ii-2) Relayer actions (seatUp/beginGame/commitMove/expireTurn) (DEPRECATED for gameplay)
(2ii-3) Live Arc proof (begin, lapse, permissionless expire, move)
(2ii-4a) Client can reach the on-chain clock (adapter + gateway passthrough)
(2ii-4b) Bridge watches the chain deadline and calls expireTurn as a stall fallback
(2ii-4c) FIX start-commit race (the idle tick re-entered the async start); single-flight guard on ensureStarted
(2iii) Win/finish order + result on-chain
(2iii-1) settleGameOrder + resultOrder on-chain, relayer + gateway, live proof
(2iii-2) Bridge settles the finish order at the ceremony (DEPRECATED: folds into (1v))
(2iii-3) DIAGNOSED the two live start txs (6 Aug window): 0xad..8448 SUCCESS, 0xa0..5ff3 FAILED with Exists() - an identical duplicate, not a settlement failure
(2iv) House/AI rolls derive from the committed Arc seed
(2v) LIVE TEST: owner played a match (works, revealed the cost problem -> (1v))
(2vi) Off-chain match engine: session-key-signed move list + timers off-chain, ZERO txs during play
(2vii) On-chain START COMMIT (players + match id + commitment + clock; life charged here)
(2vii-a) Contract commitStart built + deployed + 6 forge tests
(2vii-b) Wire Ludo via the GAME-AGNOSTIC rail: call start() at match start
(2viii) ONE co-signed per-MATCH settlement
(2viii-a) Contract settle() built + co-signature enforcement proved
(2viii-b) Wire Ludo via the rail: engine.move() per turn + co-sign settle at the ceremony
(2xi) Retire the per-action path from the hot path
(2ix) Commit-reveal dispute + game-agnostic snapshot REPLAY
(2ix-a) Dispute is a FREE off-chain signed event (like a move); no bond, no fee; rides the same batch
(2ix-b) Free off-chain verifier replay (Ludo rule replayer first)
(2ix-c) Replay result batched like any other settlement event
(2x) Timeout claim / expiry (contract done; wire client)

(2x-b) FIX the logout hole: the single-player board survives sign-out in localStorage, so a started match stays playable with no account (free unlimited play). Needs one-source-of-truth enforcement (see (17)).
(2x-a) Contract guards confirmed on Arc: NoMatch, AlreadySettled, BadSig, NotExpired, NotPlayer, Exists (custom errors, so the UI must decode them)
(2v-b) LIVE TEST #2: play a match, confirm ZERO per-move charges + start/end + history links
(3) Lives + anti-bypass (chain-enforced)
(3i) Free tier is L0 not L1; tier read from PlayerCore on Arc
(3ii) Daily lives reset TIMER on-chain, 24h GMT+00 from block time
(3ii-1) chargeLife on-chain resets by block-time day (livesDay) + pool by tier
(3ii-2) Lives module reads the on-chain pool/used/day on Arc
(3ii-3) Confirm the daily reset countdown matches the chain day boundary (live check)
(3iii) Life charged at match START; no separate charge tx; non-refundable
(3v) FIX: lives meter refreshes IMMEDIATELY at game start (game-agnostic)
(3iv) Ladder on-chain L0 5/L1 10/L2 15/L3 20 + upkeep expiry; balances restored
(4) Subscription + premium (DIRECT USDC: no premium-points intermediary)
(4i) L0..L3 ladder on-chain, config-driven; header reads true level
(4i-1) Header reads true level from PlayerCore on Arc
(4i-2) Config-driven plan ladder (levels, premium cost, multipliers, prices as data)
(4ii) Direct activation L2 2x / L3 3x, 30 days, EXPIRY TIMER on-chain
(4ii-1) activate on Arc (relayer admin write) + 30-day window from block time, live proof
(4ii-2) Tier boost at M4 flow-up uses the live level (kind=1 credit) on Arc + spend path; live proof
(4ii-3) FULLY AUTOMATIC payment: relayer watches Arc for the confirmed USDC payment, then splits + activates; hard guard
(4ii-3a) arcv2m15 splitter: 20% referrer / 30% escrow / 50% admin atomically
(4ii-3b) Escrow contract on Arc holding the 30% competition pool
(4ii-3c) Relayer payment watcher: verify amount/recipient/replay, then split + activate
(4iii) Unlimited-lives booster: DIRECT USDC purchase + WINDOW TIMER on-chain
(4iii-1) Other in-game assets: DIRECT USDC purchase pattern (no points intermediary)
(4iv) Daily rewards with 24h reset (fold into (1v): no standalone daily tx)
(4v) Premium-points LEDGER RETIREMENT from the purchase flow
(5) Point sources
(5i) Signup bonus 500P, on-chain once-per-wallet fence (fold into (1v): no per-award tx)
(5ii) Affiliate 20% ONCE per referral on their FIRST paid subscription (NOT monthly, NOT 12 months); active-sub gate at that moment; one payout per referral forever
(5iii) Manual payout only (no cron, no external automation)
(6) Competitions (arcv2m7)
(6i) Config-driven on-chain instances (tiers multi, games multi, entry, window+duration, pool, shares)
(6ii) Final-points x LIVE tier boost (L3 1.5x); downgrade hides instantly; L0 at freeze gets no position
(6iii) Window start/end/duration enforced on-chain (use the (1v) clock + settlement, no per-tick txs)
(6iv) On-chain winners + paid status; public past-winners
(7) Multiplayer (arcv2m12)
(7i) Match codes/join, seat ownership
(7ii) Turn clocks + permissionless forfeit (use the (1v) clock; forfeit only at settlement/dispute)
(7iii) Finish -> seam, one entry one result (emit into the (1v) per-match settlement)
(8) Other games
(8i) Chess on Arc (must use the (1v) rail: zero per-move txs; needs its own on-chain replayer)
(8ii) Ayo Olopon + future games drop-in (same rail; replayer added when it carries money)
(9) AGM (arcv2m14)
(9i) Player-created challenges, maker-to-taker matching
(9ii) Escrow in supported tokens, atomic settle (money moves on-chain; play rides (1v); needs an on-chain replayer)
(9iii) Attaches to the same windows
(10) Scale proof for 50-100+ games
(10i) One leaf type + per-game tag; adding a game is data, not a contract
(10ii) Cost model at 100 games and high volume (batched, ~0.0006/day at launch; $0.027/1,000 at N=100)
(10iii) No new account per game or feature
(11) Verification protocol (no false done)
(11i) Every item proven with an Arc explorer link
(11ii) Confirm Solana is not powering the feature (no runtime call)
(11iii) Confirm nothing off-chain as core truth AND nothing charges per action
(12) Silence Solana
(12i) Remove runtime Solana calls from the Arc path

(12i-2) CONFIRMED the multiplayer rail (public/universal/multiplayer/multiplayer.js) still runs on Solana via src/magicblock-er-vrf.js (joinBoardMatch/commitMove/finishBoardMatch) - it must move to Arc or be retired before Solana is silenced
(12ii) No page/module/fallback can touch Solana while on Arc
(13) Dashboard: batch flush timer state (read-only, free)

(16) DICE MODEL on Arc (owner question 2026-09-21: why is dice not free inside the batch)

(16i) Measured fact: the Arc dice derivation is ALREADY gasless and off-chain - the relayer derives the roll from the committed seed (rollDice) at ZERO gas and ZERO tx; it is NOT a Solana write once the page bug above is fixed

(16iii) DECISION (owner 2026-09-21): derive dice from the BATCHED WINDOW root at flush time - no relayer seed secret, no separate on-chain commit, zero extra cost, rolls stay free derivations like moves
(16iv) Prove-ability trade-off accepted: a roll is verifiable when the window flushes (usually within the hour), not instantly, because the window root is the seal
(16v) Build the batched-window dice derivation (remove GFG_Arc_Dice_Seed), then prove one real roll recomputable from the on-chain window root

(16ii) DECISION NEEDED from the owner: the seed is currently a relayer env secret committed, not yet revealed/finalised in the window; nothing stores the per-roll dice on-chain, so proof needs the seed reveal + window Merkle proof - confirm this model or ask for dice randomness derived fully from the batched window (no env secret)
(17) SINGLE-PLAYER BOARD: one source of truth (no localStorage, survives reload + logout)

(17v) OWNER CLARIFICATION (2026-09-21): "onchain" means the GFG-BS model - everything in between (dice, moves, points) is signed, sealed in the window Merkle tree, and provable via the start+end commit. It does NOT mean a tx per move, and it does NOT mean frontend/Vercel/Supabase/localStorage as truth.

(17vi) REQUIRED BEHAVIOUR: a player can sign out, sign back in on ANY device, and continue the same match - unless it was flushed by the standard window (then it is final). While NOT flushed it resumes; once logged out it must NEVER be playable offline. No localStorage, because a stale local copy can conflict with the window Merkle tree and replay stale actions.

(17vii) BUILD: persist the in-flight match as SIGNED match events addressed to the player (not editable localStorage), so any device can rehydrate the board from signed state and reconcile with the window; drop the raw board snapshot entirely.
(17viii) Remove the localStorage board snapshot from the resume path (replace with signed rehydrate); keep only non-authoritative UI prefs if any remain.
(17i) FIX the save-on-signout hole: discard the local match on gfg:auth-changed (logout) so a started game cannot continue with no account; the life stays spent (non-refundable)
(17ii) FIX reload: rebuild the live board from the signed off-chain move log held in memory for the match window, or drop it - never resume from editable localStorage
(17iii) Confirmed design: keep moves off-chain inside the signed window (2 txs + 1 flush per match); do NOT add a tx per move, which would break the GFG-BS cost model
(17iv) Analyse and report whether this fully closes the logout/double-tx loophole, then implement
(18) PUBLIC explorer readability: verify the contracts so the official Arc explorer decodes our function + event names instead of "contract call"
(18i) Confirmed: this is Circle ArcScan "Verify & Publish"; the same flow carries to Arc mainnet unchanged (ERC-20/contract verification is standard)
(18ii) Verify MatchSettlement, PlayerCore, GameRegistry, Randomness on ArcScan (needs the explorer verification flow / an owner API key)
(18iii) After verifying, confirm a live tx shows MatchStarted / MatchSettled by name
(19) FULL PROJECT RESCAN (owner 2026-09-21): Arc blockers found auditing every todo item 1..end

(19i) FIXED ROOT BLOCKER: window.GFG_CHAIN was only set on /games/ludo-lab (main-lab.js); every other page loaded src/main.js which never set it, so chain-gateway fell back to svm and all isArc() guards took the Solana branch on an Arc build. Now set in src/main.js too.

(19ii) FIXED Solana write on Arc: win-detection.js called window.magicblockDice.recordResult directly instead of the chain gateway (which routes to Arc). Now goes through window.gfgChain.recordResult.

(19iii) BLOCKER: public/universal/points/local-points.js has NO isArc() guard on its READ path - it calls sdk.fetchPointsPdaFor/fetchPointsPda (Solana) unconditionally, on every page (header injects it). Must route reads through the gateway/Arc adapter.

(19iv) BLOCKER: public/universal/ledgers/global-ledger.js has NO isArc() guard on its READ path - same Solana fetchGlobalPointsPdaFor/fetchGlobalPointsPda calls unconditionally. Must route through the gateway/Arc adapter.

(19v) BLOCKER: local-points.spend and premium-ledger.spend call window.magicblockDice.spendLocal/spendPremiumPoints directly (Solana writes) when competitions entry runs. Must route through gfgChain.spendLocal/spendGlobal.
(19vi) BLOCKER: premium-ledger read falls through to the Solana fetch when arcReadLedger() returns null (no early return). Must return an honest empty/error instead of hitting Solana.
(19vii) BLOCKER: public/profile-core.js fetchPointsPda/fetchGlobalPointsPda/fetchPremiumPointsPdaFor (3 reads) and profile/upgrade.html (2 reads) call the Solana SDK directly; no isArc() guard.

(19viii) BLOCKER: the whole competitions path (universal/competitions/competition-engine.js + /api/competitions + scripts/competitions-relay.mjs) is Solana-only but runs on every page (refresh at module load). Must move to Arc or be disabled on Arc until (6) is built.

(19ix) BLOCKER: profile/upgrade.html and payment/index.html: payment/index.html unconditionally imports src/gfg-pay.js which imports @solana/web3.js + @solana/spl-token and builds Solana USDC transactions; upgrade.html reads premium via the Solana SDK. Payment on Arc must be direct USDC (see (4)).
(19x) BLOCKER: games/chess/index.html is entirely Solana (md().read/ai/move/create/start/join/resign/offerDraw) with no isArc() guard. Chess on Arc is item (8i).

(19xi) BLOCKER: the multiplayer rail is Solana (already tracked as (12i-2)); the ludo lives gate window.mpCheckLives reads via md.readLivesFor (Solana) with an EVM address on Arc. Must use the Arc lives reader.
(19xii) LOADER: src/main.js and src/main-lab.js always import + configure the Solana SDK (magicblock-er-vrf.js) on every page. Must not load/configure Solana on an Arc build (or load inert).

(19xiii) WRONG-CHAIN MATH: matchRefFromSignature/boostRefFromSignature (local-points, global-ledger, premium-ledger) use the Solana SDK on Arc; the Arc proof token is hex, not base58. Route via gateway.

(19xiv) SERVER: several /api/* handlers the client calls on Arc are Solana relays (/api/multiplayer, /api/competitions, /api/agm, /api/affiliate, /api/signup, /api/chess). Confirm which must become Arc or be blocked when on Arc.

(19xv) STANDALONE TOOLS: verify/verify.js, dashboard/recovery.html, dashboard/premium.html, dashboard/premium-subscribers.html, public/dash-core.js, dashboard/ops.html still probe/read/write Solana. Decide keep-as-Solana-tooling vs migrate before declaring Solana silenced.

(19xvi) CONFIRMED-CLEAN: src/chain/svm.js is only imported when CHAIN!=evm (dead on Arc); api_handlers/arc-relay.mjs has no Solana imports; settlement/lives/premium-activate/match-history ARE properly isArc()-guarded.
(19xvii) Re-run this full audit AFTER (19iii)-(19xv) are fixed, and only then mark (11)/(12) Verification + Silence Solana done.

migrationNote: MOVING 100% FROM SOLANA TO ARC. The Arc chain is the source of truth for every feature (lives, points, tiers, competitions, match settlement). The frontend only displays what the chain holds. The one old Solana write left in the game page (dice) is tracked below and must be retired before Solana can be silenced.
